headline: Bajel Projects wins Rs 200-300 crore order for Mumbai substations
hook: New infrastructure win for Bajel Projects
summary: Bajel Projects has secured a contract valued between Rs 200 crore and Rs 300 crore. The order involves the construction of Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) substations in Mumbai. This project adds to the company's existing order book in the power infrastructure sector.
why_it_matters: Revenue visibility improves for the company's power infrastructure segment.

headline: Bajel Projects issues press release to stock exchanges
hook: New corporate update from Bajel Projects
summary: Bajel Projects Limited has submitted a press release to the stock exchanges dated October 9, 2026. The filing notes an official corporate communication without detailing specific financial metrics or order wins in the exchange intimation. Retail investors should review the full press release on the company's website or exchange portal for specific business developments.
why_it_matters: Routine filing; check the press release for specific business updates.

headline: Bajel Projects secures order worth up to ₹300 crore from Tata Power
hook: New Mumbai grid contracts for Bajel
summary: Bajel Projects has bagged an EPC order from Tata Power to supply and install 220 kV GIS substations in Salsette and Powai, Mumbai. The contract carries an 18-month execution timeline from the date of the purchase order. For retail investors holding Bajel Projects, this major win reinforces order book visibility in the transmission and distribution segment.
why_it_matters: Order book bolsters near-term revenue visibility for Bajel Projects.

headline: Bajel Projects announces bagging new orders or contracts
hook: New order wins secured by Bajel
summary: Bajel Projects Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges that it has secured new orders or contracts. The filing provides minimal detail regarding the financial size or the identity of the clients involved in the contract wins. Routine order wins of this nature typically have a mild, company-specific impact on listed infrastructure and power transmission entities. Retail investors should track future disclosures for order values to gauge potential revenue growth.
whats_next: Company disclosure on order values and execution timelines
why_it_matters: Order inflows support revenue visibility for Bajel shareholders.

headline: Bajel Projects submits postal ballot scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Postal ballot voting results now official
summary: Bajel Projects Limited has officially submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results of its recent postal ballot to the stock exchanges. This routine corporate filing concludes the shareholder voting process on resolutions put forth by the company. Shareholders and investors can review the outcome of the ballot on exchange portals. For Indian retail investors, such procedural filings offer administrative updates but have no direct impact on the stock's near-term price.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate update with no immediate financial impact.
